status: PROPOSAL (PO-06). Rehearsed only on loopback, disposable *_test_only_* databases with fictional data. Not approved for any real database: decision D-6 is the owner's. The tool that reads this file refuses every other target before it connects.

drizzle-kit push after S08 while the staged user_invitations declaration is outside src/db/schema: its plan is ALTER TABLE "user_invitations" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and DROP TABLE "user_invitations" CASCADE (rehearsal finding D6-F1)
drizzle-kit migrate or drizzle-kit generate: the committed journal builds 59 tables against the schema's 80 (db:preflight reports INCONSISTENT)
any file of this manifest by hand, in a different order, or with psql -1 / inside an outer BEGIN

server.minimumReason: CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER (PO01) and the server_version_num checks inside PO02A, PO02D1 and PO03C
server.searchPath: the session's current schema is public
server.connection: a direct connection: the autocommit CONCURRENTLY steps cannot run through a transaction-mode pooler
privileges: CREATE on the database (each reviewed file builds its scratch reference schema inside its own transaction)
ownership of users and sessions (S01, S03, S04 and S05 add an index or a constraint to them)
REFERENCES on orgs, users and the platform tables (new foreign keys)
the same role for every step; no step changes a role, a grant or a setting outside its own transaction

targets.accepted: a loopback-only PostgreSQL server and a database whose name contains _test_only_ (scripts/platform/local-db-guard.ts: URL form, loopback host, name marker, then server-side loopback, listen_addresses and current_database checks)
targets.staging: the PO-06 recommendation: a PostgreSQL server on the isolated staging host, listening on 127.0.0.1 only, holding one fictional-data database named with _test_only_ (for example elite_staging_test_only_01); the guarded tools then work unchanged, the Trial seed included (its SQL refuses any other database name by itself)
targets.production: not supported by this tool. A production mode (an approved target list, a dedicated migration role, a maintenance window) is part of decision D-6 and is not built.

pins.$comment: Catalog fingerprints from scripts/platform/catalog.ts projectCatalog(): platform = every platform-owned table, column, constraint, index, trigger, function and sequence; other = everything else in public. Computed in PO-06 on two independent clean copies of the 621f156 schema (identical) and re-checked by the rehearsal on every shape.

usersKeyLines: users | users_org_id_id_uq | u | UNIQUE (id, org_id) | validated | immediate
users | users_org_id_id_uq | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_org_id_id_uq ON public.users USING btree (id, org_id)

baseSchema.$comment: The other-projection of a NEW database after B00: exactly the customer ERP schema of main 621f156 (drizzle-kit push of main's own configuration plus drizzle/immutable_audit.sql produced a byte-identical pg_dump --schema-only, 5,240 lines, sha256 c0e02373…).

base.name: erp-base-schema
base.title: NEW database only: the customer ERP schema at the 621f156 shape, then the immutable-audit hardening
base.when: only on an empty new database (staging). Refused when public holds any table. Never on an existing ERP database.
base.execution: restricted push: scripts/platform/disposable-db.ts pushPreCompanyTenantSchema (the tenant schema modules only, minus M4 and the users key — the 621f156 shape), then drizzle/immutable_audit.sql
base.expectedAfter: other-projection digest = pins.baseSchema.otherDigest; no platform object (platformDigest = pins.platformDigest.none)
base.retry: refused on a non-empty database: a failed B00 is recovered by dropping and re-creating the new database
base.locks: a new, empty database: none that any user can feel
base.onFailure: drop the new database and start again; nothing else exists yet
base.rollback: drop the new staging database (it holds nothing but the schema)

forward.name: target-check
forward.title: Read-only target check and release preflight
checks: the local-db-guard accepts the target (loopback-only server, _test_only_ name)
PostgreSQL >= 14, UTF8, not a standby, current schema public
an Elite ERP database (orgs.id, users.id, users.org_id, users.email, sessions.org_id)
no leftover scratch schema (po02a_reference, po02d1_reference, po03c_reference)
the immutable-audit triggers audit_logs_immutable and security_events_immutable exist, are enabled and are bound to their tables
the release preflight's state is REVIEWED_SQL_NOT_APPLIED or REVIEWED_SQL_COMPLETE; PARTIAL_PUSH_CREATED, PARTIAL_OR_DRIFTED and UNSUPPORTED_TARGET stop here with the preflight's recovery text
the platform catalog fingerprint equals one of pins.platformDigest (otherwise: drifted, stop)
forward.onFailure: nothing has been changed; follow the recovery the finding names (PO02D1A1_MIGRATION_HARDENING.md §F.6 for a push-created partial schema)

forward.name: m4-sessions-index-concurrently
forward.title: M4 sessions_org_active_idx built CONCURRENTLY (large sessions table)
forward.when: REQUIRED (--concurrent-indexes) on any database in use — staging with testers, and production: S03's plain M4 build holds SHARE on sessions (every sign-in's session write waits) for the build. Only on an empty, disposable database may S03 build M4 itself.
forward.expectedAfter: pins.m4Lines present; the index valid and ready
forward.retry: a no-op when the valid, identical index exists; refuses over an INVALID leftover and prints DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY public.sessions_org_active_idx
forward.locks: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE on sessions: reads and writes continue; the build waits for transactions already open when it starts; no timeout inside (bounded by the maintenance window)
forward.onFailure: an interrupted build leaves an INVALID index: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY public.sessions_org_active_idx, then run S01 again

forward.name: po01-platform-identity
forward.title: PO-01A platform identity: four platform tables, platform_reject_mutation(), the append-only audit triggers
forward.expectedAfter: pins.platformDigest.afterS02; checkPlatformObjects OK; preflight component po01a complete
forward.retry: idempotent (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE OR REPLACE). It cannot see a differently shaped table of the same name, so the tool's catalog fingerprint check is what refuses a malformed pre-existing object (rehearsal scenario G)
forward.locks: measured (PO-06 C5): SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on orgs until COMMIT (the platform_audit_events.org_id foreign key); ACCESS EXCLUSIVE only on the four new platform tables. A verify-only re-run (CREATE OR REPLACE of the function and triggers) locks only platform tables (SHARE / SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on platform_admins and platform_audit_events)
forward.onFailure: one transaction: nothing persists; fix the cause and run again

forward.name: po02a-company-foundation
forward.title: PO-02A company foundation: tenant_access_controls, organization_invitations, M4 (verify or create), the audit entity index
forward.expectedAfter: pins.platformDigest.afterS03; pins.m4Lines present; checkCompanyFoundation OK; preflight component po02a complete
forward.retry: absent -> created; identical -> verified, untouched; any difference -> the whole file aborts naming every difference. The corrected reference schema (PO-02D1A.1) uses stand-ins, so a verify-only re-run locks no customer table
forward.locks: measured (PO-06 C5/C6): SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on orgs and platform_admins until COMMIT; ACCESS EXCLUSIVE only on the two new tables. Without S01 the plain M4 build holds SHARE on sessions until COMMIT (session writes wait). A verify-only re-run holds only ACCESS SHARE
forward.onFailure: one transaction: nothing persists. An INVALID M4 left by an interrupted S01 is refused with its recovery

forward.name: users-key-concurrently
forward.title: F1 users_org_id_id_uq built CONCURRENTLY, then attached as the UNIQUE (id, org_id) constraint

timeouts.lock: 0 for the build; 5s for the attach

forward.when: REQUIRED (--concurrent-indexes) on any database whose users table is in use — staging with testers, and production. Only on an empty, disposable database may S05 build the key itself: that plain path holds ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users until S05 commits (rehearsal finding D6-F4).
forward.expectedAfter: pins.usersKeyLines present; preflight component f1 complete
forward.retry: a no-op when the valid, attached key exists; refuses over an INVALID leftover or a different definition and prints the recovery
forward.locks: build: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE on users (reads and writes continue; waits for transactions already open). Attach: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users for the catalog change only (no scan), bounded by lock_timeout 5s
forward.onFailure: an interrupted build leaves an INVALID index: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY public.users_org_id_id_uq, then run S04 again

forward.name: po02d1-onboarding-foundation
forward.title: PO-02D1 onboarding foundation: seven tables, three guard functions, ten triggers, the users key (verify or create)
forward.expectedAfter: pins.platformDigest.afterS05; pins.usersKeyLines present; checkOnboardingFoundation OK; preflight PUSH_SAFE and REVIEWED_SQL_COMPLETE
forward.retry: absent -> created; identical -> verified; any difference -> the whole file aborts naming every difference
forward.locks: measured (PO-06 C5/C7): after S04, SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on orgs, users, platform_admins and organization_invitations until COMMIT, nothing stronger on a customer table. WITHOUT S04 the users key is built inside this transaction by ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT … UNIQUE: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users until COMMIT — every read of users (each sign-in and session check) waits for the whole transaction (D6-F4). A verify-only re-run holds no lock on any watched table
forward.onFailure: one transaction: nothing persists; an INVALID users key is refused with its recovery

forward.name: foundation-gate
forward.title: Read-only gate before any row is written
checks: the release preflight reports PUSH_SAFE and REVIEWED_SQL_COMPLETE (the Trial seed runner refuses otherwise)
checkPlatformObjects, checkCompanyFoundation and checkOnboardingFoundation all OK
no scratch schema, no INVALID index, every trigger in public enabled
the immutable-audit triggers still present and enabled
forward.onFailure: stop; the foundation is installed but unverified — investigate before any seed

forward.name: trial-seed
forward.title: PO-02D1B default Trial package, its published version 1 and the platform settings row
forward.runner: scripts/platform/trial-seed.ts runSeed() — guard, then the release preflight (PUSH_SAFE + REVIEWED_SQL_COMPLETE), then the SQL, then a read-only post-check
forward.when: always (owner decision: the Trial values of PO02D1B_DEVELOPMENT.md §D)
forward.approval: D-6 and the Trial values (T-1 … T-8)
forward.expectedAfter: checkTrialSeed state complete; platform fingerprint unchanged (rows only)
forward.retry: absent -> inserted; equal to the approved values -> verified, nothing written (not even an audit record); different -> refused, naming every difference
forward.locks: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on the three platform catalog tables; no customer table is read or written
forward.onFailure: one transaction: nothing persists. The SQL refuses by itself any database not named *_test_only_ on a loopback-only server

forward.name: po03c-user-invitations
forward.title: PO-03C staged user_invitations table, user_invitation_guard() and its two triggers
forward.when: only after the owner approves L-3 (the staged schema). It is not part of PLATFORM_SQL_FILES, so npm run platform:db:apply never runs it.
forward.expectedAfter: pins.po03c (38 catalog lines, digest aaec6979…) present; platform fingerprint unchanged; no other customer object changed
forward.retry: absent -> created; identical -> verified; any difference -> abort naming every difference
forward.locks: measured (PO-06 C4/C5): SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on orgs, users and platform_admins until COMMIT, nothing stronger; a verify-only re-run holds no lock on any watched table
forward.afterwards: the release preflight reports BLOCKED with exactly two X-01 findings — ALTER TABLE "user_invitations" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and DROP TABLE "user_invitations" CASCADE: a push of src/db/schema would drop the staged table. Correct and expected while L-3 keeps the declaration in src/db/staged — it is why push must never run after S08 (neverRun); the seed runner, which needs PUSH_SAFE, therefore refuses after S08 until R08 has run

forward.name: final-verification
forward.title: Read-only final verification
checks: platform fingerprint = pins.platformDigest.afterS05; pins.m4Lines and pins.usersKeyLines present
the PO-03C objects match pins.po03c exactly
checkPlatformObjects, checkCompanyFoundation, checkOnboardingFoundation OK; checkTrialSeed complete
no scratch schema, no INVALID index, every trigger in public enabled, the immutable-audit triggers present
the release preflight: BLOCKED with exactly the two X-01 findings for user_invitations (expected after S08); PUSH_SAFE when S08 was not run

rollback.preconditions: the application no longer writes user_invitations (PLATFORM_USER_INVITATIONS_ENABLED off, or the release rolled back)
rollback.refuses: while user_invitations holds ANY row (open, expired, revoked or accepted): nothing is changed and no audit record is added
rollback.effect: drops the table, its two triggers and user_invitation_guard(); appends one platform audit record schema.user_invitations_removed; a repeated run adds nothing
rollback.locks: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on orgs, users and platform_admins until COMMIT (milliseconds)

rollback.runner: scripts/platform/trial-seed.ts runSeed(url, { rollback: true }) — needs the preflight PUSH_SAFE, so R08 must run first
rollback.refuses: while anything references the Trial (a subscription, an invitation term, a second version) or the rows differ from the approved seed: nothing is removed
rollback.effect: removes Trial version 1, the Trial package and the settings row; appends one audit record

rollback.refuses: while ANY of the seven onboarding tables holds a row (so R07 first)
rollback.effect: drops the seven tables (their ten triggers go with them) and the three guard functions; the users key stays (R04)
rollback.locks: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on orgs, users, platform_admins and organization_invitations until COMMIT (milliseconds)

timeouts.lock: 5s for the constraint drop; 0 for DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY

rollback.refuses: while the primary-owner foreign key (R05 not yet run) still depends on the key
rollback.effect: drops the constraint (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users for the catalog change, no scan) or a bare/INVALID index CONCURRENTLY; appends one audit record when something is removed

rollback.preconditions: on a large sessions table first run, in autocommit: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS public.sessions_org_active_idx
rollback.refuses: while tenant_access_controls or organization_invitations holds a row
rollback.effect: drops the two PO-02A tables, M4 and the audit entity index

NO reviewed rollback exists for PO-01A. Its tables hold the append-only platform audit trail; removing them destroys evidence and needs its own owner-approved, backed-up plan (rehearsal finding D6-F3). The objects are inert while PLATFORM_CONSOLE_ENABLED is off.
